messages:
Ava: Hey kitchen folks — quick heads up: there are three basil pots on the windowsill that need watering. If someone can water them once this week that'd be awesome :seedling:

Devon: On it. I can do Wed morning. @Sam can you check the espresso grinder? It sounds a bit louder than usual.

Sam: Noted. Left a sticky note on the machine: 'calibrate burrs?'. I'll try a quick reseat after lunch. If anyone has a 2mm hex key please bring it.

KitchenBot: Inventory alert — Low: Oatmilk (1 carton), Everything bagels (3), Vanilla syrup (empty).

Ava: Oatmilk shortage — can someone pick up 2 cartons during their run? I can Venmo. Also found an unlabeled Tupperware with cinnamon crumb inside. Who's missing it?

Devon: I can swing by the store at 4pm. Anything else I should grab? Also that Tupperware sounds delicious — not mine though.

Sam: That's mine! Thanks, mystery solved 😅 Also can we standardize a label format? Quick idea:```Label: Name | Date | Contents``` Maybe print a sheet of stickers so people actually use them.

Ava: Yes please. If someone can print & cut a sheet, I'll tape them near the shelf. And small fun idea: 'Scone Roulette' on Fridays — person of the week brings scones and everyone gets surprised. Vote? :cookie:

Devon: Vote yes. I volunteer week of 4/12.

Lina: Love the herb windowsill idea — I can bring small plant food tabs. Coffee note: medium grind worked better for the pour-overs this morning, leaving a tiny sign on the counter.

Sam: Re: grinder — if calibration doesn't improve it we should book pro maintenance. It's been ~9 months since service.

Ava: :heart: thanks everyone. I'll update the fridge stickers and put a 'please label' sticky on the shelf. Who wants basil cuttings? Free to a good home.

Devon: Me please. Also leaving a pastry on the counter for anyone who wants to grab one :croissant:

KitchenBot: Reminder: Dishwasher load completed by @OpsTeam at 13:02.

Ava: Closing loop — I'll print the label template and tack it up, and I'll text the 4pm store-run group with a shopping list (2 oatmilk, syrup, spare hex key). Thanks team!
